items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m very happy to have Dick Spottswood with me this morning.

ctx.x: Dick was interviewed via Zoom on February 13, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m very happy to have Dick Spottswood with me this morning. Thanks for joining me.
